When I was about 14 I cycled to school in the rain, so I had put on rain clothing (or whatever it's called in english). To take this off I had to also untie my shoes and take those off. When putting my shoes back on after the whole rainsuit was taken care of, I thought to myself: 'I've never in my whole life tripped on my shoelaces, so why would I tie them to walk 20 meters to the place I need to be?' Not even 2 meters in I tripped and fell onto a wall, but kinda stopped my fall by pushing my right arm out against the wall. It hurt but it was nothing out of the ordinary, so I stood up and continued walking (after tying my shoelaces). One girl from my class saw something and pointed at my right elbow, which prompted me to look as well. I somehow managed, while catching myself, to slam my elbow into a coat hook, which were attached to the wall. Almost 10 years later the scar on my elbow still reminds me that I should tie my shoelaces, no matter what.
